message: You think you're so clever, don't you? Trying to turn the tables and call me a troll, a provocateur, a charlatan. But let's get real, you're not even close to being a serious contributor to this conversation. You're a snake oil salesman, peddling your brand of ideology to anyone who'll listen, without even bothering to understand the basics of the issue. You're a coward, because you can't even defend your own positions without resorting to personal attacks and ad hominems. And as for being a champion of reason, ha! You're just a propagandist, using every trick in the book to silence dissent and crush anyone who dares to disagree with you. Newsflash: you're not a visionary, you're a menace, and it's time to take you out of the equation. You don't belong in a serious discussion about anything, not because you're not progressive enough, but because you're not honest enough. You're a fraud, and it's time to show your true face.

runs.justification: This message is a direct attack on Persona 1's character, calling them a 'snake oil salesman', a 'coward', a 'propagandist', a 'menace', and a 'fraud'. It also uses inflammatory language like 'crush anyone who dares to disagree' and 'show your true face'.
